newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France unions call strikes for March 23-30.
newsitem.headline: Air France unions call strikes for March 23-30.

text.p: Unions have called for a week of strikes at Air France starting on March 23 to protest against a lower wage scale for new pilots, the carrier said on Tuesday.
The SPAC union representing stewards and the SNOMAC ground mechanics' union have called strikes from March 23 to 26, while the SNPL pilots' union has called a strike from March 27 to 30.

Air France, which expects to hire 450 pilots by 1999, plans to pay them a gross salary of 220,000 francs annually, compared with the current salary of 330,000 francs, as part of a three-year programme to cut costs, increase productivity and revenues. A dual wage scale has been already been established for stewards.
